problem: The shape restricts the datatype of every required numeric value to xsd:decimal via FILTER(datatype(?v) = xsd:decimal). The requirement does not prescribe a specific datatype, so valid data using other numeric types (e.g., xsd:double) would be incorrectly flagged as non‑conforming.
required_change: Remove the datatype equality test or broaden it to accept any numeric datatype (e.g., xsd:double, xsd:float, xsd:decimal).
regression_guard: Preserve removal of datatype check to keep datatype flexibility.

problem: The requirement mandates that platingHullAreaClassification must be one of the controlled hull‑area individuals BI_b, M_b or S_b. The shape only checks that the property exists, without constraining its object to those specific individuals, thus omitting an obligatory semantic restriction.
required_change: Add a constraint (e.g., VALUES or FILTER) that limits the object of nltl:platingHullAreaClassification to exactly the IRIs https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#bowIntermediateBottomHullArea, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#midbodyBottomHullArea, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#sternBottomHullArea.
regression_guard: Preserve the added controlled‑value restriction for platingHullAreaClassification.
